_comment: Single source of truth for the Odin port's pinned third-party versions.
Read by tools/odinw.py (pixi path), ../flake.nix (Nix path) and Dockerfile (Docker image).
pixi.toml cannot read this file; odinw.py checks that its zeromq spec agrees.
odin.sha256: per sys.platform, of the release asset; verify with curl -sL <url> | sha256sum.
capnproto.nix_src_hash: SRI hash of the GitHub source tag; nix flake prefetch github:capnproto/capnproto/v<version>.
vcpkg_baseline: a vcpkg commit whose versions database has capnproto.version (independent of ../vcpkg_tag.txt, which only the C++ build uses).
After editing: python tools/odinw.py check-pins. Procedure: UPDATING_VERSIONS.md.
